segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cream absorbs without feeling heavy or increasing oiliness, and it is often used only at night or in smaller amounts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including several with eczema, dermatitis, rosacea or dry flaky patches, most often report significant relief from flaking, tightness and irritation, though a few say it did not moisturize as well as their usual cream or still broke them out.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin generally report good hydration on cheeks and forehead with no increase in oiliness, sometimes avoiding the T-zone, though one found it too heavy for a morning combination-skin routine.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many report soothing, non-irritating use even after actives, chemical burns or eczema flares, while others report redness, swelling, itching, chemical burn, or a chemical-smelling irritation.
segments.mature: The few mature-skin reviewers report visible improvement in hydration and skin appearance during winter.

concerns.aging: One mature-skin reviewer reports her skin has never looked better after use; feedback specific to aging is otherwise limited.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention dryness or dehydration, including winter dryness, over-exfoliation, retinol/tret dryness and eczema, report the product restores moisture, softness and comfort within days to weeks; a couple say it wasn't moisturizing enough compared to their usual cream.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness and soothing of irritated or burned skin, sometimes within minutes; one reviewer with redness-prone combination skin reports no significant reduction.
concerns.barrier: Many reviewers describe using this specifically to repair a barrier damaged by actives, over-exfoliation or acids, reporting calmer, less inflamed skin within one to two weeks; one reviewer felt it didn't really function as a repair product beyond a regular moisturizer.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers report old breakouts healing or fewer new pimples appearing, and one reports whiteheads resolving faster than usual.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and even improvement, but there is clear dissent: multiple reviewers, including some not usually prone to acne, report significant new breakouts, whiteheads or cystic-type pimples after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin mostly report the product does not increase oiliness or feel greasy, though a couple note it can feel greasy if overused or find it slightly too thick.

I have very dry, sensitive skin and had high hopes for this, but it didn't work out for me. It did seal in moisture and lasted for a lot longer on my skin than a lot of other creams, but it smelled very chemically and left my skin irritated. If you are looking for something similar to this, but not quite as irritating, try the popular Cicaplast balm over your regular moisturizer or serum.

I love this moisturizer. My skin was super irritated from both the cool, dry air and over-exfoliating - seriously, my skin felt like sandpaper from the inside out. I decided to try this because none of my other moisturizers were helping. This product immediately helped upon first application - for the first time in a week, my skin didn't feel dry and tight. I continued to use this (along with Byoma's hydrating toner and a hydrating serum) twice a day for a week and my skin went back to normal. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin that leans pretty dry and this product didnt break me out. I like that its also fragrance-free. I used one pump for my face and one pump for my neck and that was enough product. This product sat really well under my sunscreen and makeup. It also didnt leave my skin greasy or oily. The price point is great, especially of you can get it during a sale or BOGO event. I live in WI where winters are cold and dry, so I think this will be a great winter moisturizer.

I purchased this product for the first time in November. I was struggling with winter skin and tried so many barrier repair treatments and none helped but this one! I prep with the byoma milk cleanser. I do have sensitive skin and this didn't irritate my skin at all. also works so good under my hydrating foundation!

This product was gifted by Byoma for my honest opinion. In winter, this has been a blessing. It goes on a bit thick, but a little goes a long way and isn't too heavy and absorbs quickly. I have combination skin and avoid my t zone, but it leaves my cheeks and forehead flake free! I like that it's fragrance free and mixes well with my SPF and serums without making my skin too oily.

I like this Byoma Barrier+Treatment! For reference, I have combination skin that leans dry and is prone to redness. I've been using this treatment in place of my moisturizer at night. I haven't seen a significant reduction in my redness yet, but this product has acted as a great moisturizer that doesn't cause me any breakouts. It is unscented which is nice, and I really like the packaging! It's super cute and easy to use, and I love that it includes ingredients like avocado oil. I will definitely keep using this product, and recommend it! I received this product complimentary from byoma.
